title: One malformed bag entry in localStorage crashes every page (empty shop grid, blank checkout)
detail: lines() reads it.slug without checking each entry is an object. Repro: localStorage mc.bag.v1='[null]' -> pageerror "Cannot read properties of null (reading 'slug')"; home grid renders 0 of 12 cards, checkout renders no form. It persists, so the shop stays broken for that visitor until they clear site data. Fix: in read() keep only plain objects with string slug/format (list.filter(x => x && typeof x === 'object' && typeof x.slug === 'string')), and merge duplicate slug:format keys; add a unit test seeding [null], {}, and duplicate keys.

title: Bag silently does nothing when localStorage.setItem throws but getItem works (quota/locked storage)
detail: write() stores to memory on setItem failure, but read() only falls back to memory when getItem throws, so it keeps re-reading the old stored value. Repro: stub Storage.prototype.setItem to throw, press Add to bag -> badge 0, drawer empty, no 'won't be saved' note. Separately, a JSON parse error flips persistent=false forever, so the 'won't be saved' note shows even though storage works. Fix: once persistent is false, read() returns memory; treat parse errors as 'reset to []' without marking storage non-persistent.

title: Faded toast keeps intercepting taps over the drawer's Keep shopping button at 375 px
detail: .toast fades to opacity 0 but keeps z-index 80, its pointer events and its Undo button. Repro at 375x740: Remove a line, wait 5.6 s, tap the centre of Keep shopping -> elementFromPoint is the toast span; the drawer stays open. A tap on the invisible Undo would silently restore the removed item. Fix: .toast:not(.is-on){visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none} (visibility with a transition delay), and clear innerHTML after it hides.

title: Undo is unreachable by keyboard and screen-reader users while the bag drawer is open
detail: The Undo toast is outside the aria-modal drawer and the Tab trap only cycles inside the drawer. Probe: after Remove, Tab stops are only 'Shop crystals' and 'Close bag'. The spec (experience.md section 8) promises a forgiving 5 s Undo. Fix: render the undo row inside the drawer body (an inline 'Removed Amethyst · Undo' row where the line was), or mount the toast inside .drawer while it is open. Also stop the timer while the toast has focus or hover (WCAG 2.2.1).

title: Pay in person + Pay over time shows money 'due today' that nobody collects today
detail: Pickup + Pay in person + Over time -> button 'Place order · $23.75 today' and summary 'Due today $23.75', but in-person payment happens at pickup or delivery, so nothing is due today. A customer sees a charge-like promise that contradicts the 3c copy. Fix: when pay==='person', relabel to 'Pay $23.75 at pickup, then 3 payments of $23.75' (or disable over-time for in-person with a visible reason, like the shipping rule), and make the button 'Place order · pay at pickup'.

title: Checkout total goes stale when the bag changes in another tab; Place order charges the new amount
detail: The storage listener dispatches bag:external, but nothing listens for it (grep shows only the dispatch), so checkout's summary and button are not re-rendered. Repro: tab A checkout shows 'Place order · $16.00'; tab B adds a Citrine jar; tab A still shows $16.00, and submit re-syncs and places a $166.00 order. The customer agreed to one total and got another. Fix: in mount(), on storage events for mc.bag.v1 dispatch bag:change (drawer and checkout already re-render on it). In checkout's submit, compare the total shown with the recomputed total and stop with a 'Your bag changed' notice if they differ.

title: Catalogue strings interpolated into HTML without esc() (tags, slug, focus)
detail: c.tags go raw into the eyebrow, the tag chips (product.js:105, ui.js:388) and the data-tags/href attributes, as do slug and focus. These come from Melody's own data file, so this is not exploitable today, but one apostrophe or ampersand in a future tag breaks markup. Fix: wrap with esc() everywhere data reaches the HTML, matching the rest of the file.

title: Card checks are loose at the edges: 2220 is detected as Mastercard, expiry accepts 2099, debit copy says Visa/MC only but Amex passes
detail: The Mastercard 2-series regex 2(2[2-9]...) matches 2220 (the real range starts at 2221). checkExpiry accepts any YY, so 12/99 passes; real checkouts reject dates more than about 20 years out. The Debit card subtitle 'Visa or Mastercard debit' (checkout.js:14) contradicts the accepted brands. Fix: use ^(222[1-9]|22[3-9]\d|2[3-6]\d\d|27[01]\d|2720); reject years more than now+20; change the debit subtitle to 'Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover' or enforce it.

evidence: bag.js lines() drops non-object entries; parse errors reset to []; e2e 'F-001: a corrupt saved bag never breaks the shop' (4 corrupt payloads)
bag.js read() returns memory once persistent=false; parse error no longer flips persistence; e2e 'F-002' stubs setItem to throw
styles.css .toast pointer-events:none unless .is-on; undo moved into drawer; e2e 'F-003/F-004' clicks Keep shopping at 375 after 5.3 s
Undo is an in-drawer button (role=status row) focused after Remove; Enter restores; e2e 'F-003/F-004'
checkout.js firstDue(): 'at pickup'/'at delivery' for pay-in-person in summary, schedule, button and confirmation; e2e 'F-005'
ui.js storage listener dispatches bag:change so checkout re-renders; e2e 'F-006' second tab adds a 50 jar, button updates to $162.00
product.js eyebrow/tags and ui.js card tags escaped; tag hrefs encodeURIComponent
payment.js MC regex ^(5[1-5]|222[1-9]|22[3-9]\d|2[3-6]\d\d|27[01]\d|2720); expiry > now+20y = format; debit subtitle matches accepted brands; unit test 'review fixes'
